分析流程与参数

从专题 README 抽取；原文顺序保留，未跑过的部分照实标注。

把 参考/image.png（801×498 富集气泡图 panel D）像素级重建为原生可编辑 SVG。

关键实测参数

  • 绘图框：x=524..687，y=33..472；行距 pitch=15.643（28 行均匀）
  • 6 个离散列 x=[542.7, 568.0, 593.4, 618.8, 644.0, 669.5]（行 13、23 各有双气泡，共 30 个）
  • 气泡直径 = 有色像素面积法 2√(A/π)（10.8–15.5 px），颜色取核心 12 px 均值
  • 色条 x=697..710，y=149..209，渐变按 x=703 列逐 4 px 采样
  • 字体：Arial 度量（Liberation Sans 兼容，17 px 宽度/ cap 高与原图吻合）
展开其余 4 个章节（工具栈、数据格式、可视化方法、参考文献等）

交付

文件 说明
亚群富集图.svg 主交付，透明背景、自包含（viewBox 0 0 801 498，13.9 KB）
亚群富集图_预览.png 白底预览（2× 超采样渲染 + LANCZOS 缩放 + σ0.4 轻模糊贴合原图缩图纹理）
build_svg.py 复现脚本：实测数据内嵌，python3 build_svg.py 重新生成 SVG

结构（编辑分组）

  • panel-label — 面板字母 D
  • y-labels — 28 条 GO term，text-anchor=end x=515，font-size 17
  • plot-frame — 绘图框，按原图逐像素灰度画 18 条线（主线 + 两侧 AA 扩散翼）
  • bubbles — 30 个气泡，按行分组 row-1..row-28，每气泡 bubble-r{行}-c{列} 独立 ID
  • group-dots — 底部 6 个亚群圆点（与绘图区 6 个离散列同 x）
  • legend-colorbar — 渐变色条（15 个实测 stop）+ 40/30/20/10 刻度 + −log10(p.adjust) 标题
  • legend-gene-ratio — 4 个实测直径黑圆 + 0.05/0.10/0.15/0.20 标签

踩过的坑

  1. linearGradient offset 必须 0–1：写了 (y-149)/61*100 导致所有 offset >1 被 clamp，色条渲染成近乎纯色；去掉 *100 后渐变正常。
  2. 降部污染测量：按行 band 测文字 bbox 时，上一行的 g/p/y 降部会伸进下一行 band，把左端 x0 拉小几十 px——逐行宽度对比必须先排除（用 thr=200 + 与渲染对照），否则会误判"字体不对"。
  3. 原图是缩图：框线/文字带 4 px 宽的 AA 扩散翼（框线主像素两侧还有半透明翼），直接画 1 px 纯线 diff 高达 26；按实测灰度补全 AA 翼后降到 ~3。
  4. 预览渲染：cairosvg 直接渲 801 出的字形比 PIL 度量窄约 2%（逐字符定位累积），系统内无更好渲染器（resvg 反而更差）；剩余文字 diff 来自字距微差，属渲染器极限。2× 超采样 + LANCZOS 再缩回明显优于直接渲。
  5. 字体族名：cairosvg 对 Arial, Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif 取 Arial（fontconfig alias → Liberation Sans）；测试其他字体时必须用 fc-list 里的族名而非文件名，否则解析失败静默回退。

验收

与原图逐像素对比（最终预览）：全图平均绝对差 9.86/255，气泡区 2.0、框线 ≤5、图例 4.4；残余差异集中在文字字形的字距/AA 纹理（原图缩图 vs 矢量清晰渲染），布局、内容、颜色、大小均已对齐。

分析代码

1 个源码文件，按目录顺序；本机绝对路径已替换为 ~。 代码可复制，但需要按自己的数据改路径与参数。

build_svg.py python · 10334 bytes 
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
1013_亚群富集图 — 参考图像素级重建为原生 SVG
参考: 参考/image.png (801x498)
所有几何/颜色均由参考图实测提取:
  - 绘图框 x=524..687 y=33..472 (H边2px, V边1px)
  - 28 行标签, 行距 pitch=15.643, 行中心 top+(i+0.5)*pitch
  - 6 个离散列 x=[542.7,568,593.4,618.8,644,669.5], 底部6个亚群圆点同列
  - 30 个气泡: 圆心/直径(面积法)/颜色(核心12px均值) 逐行实测
  - 色条 x=697..710 y=149..209 渐变逐点采样; Gene Ratio 圆 4 个实测直径
"""
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / "亚群富集图.svg"

W, H = 801, 498

# ---------------- 实测数据 ----------------
TOP, BOTTOM = 33.5, 471.5
NROW = 28
PITCH = (BOTTOM - TOP) / NROW  # 15.643
TEXT_RIGHT = 515.0             # 标签右对齐边界 (实测 ink 右缘 x=513, 按 advance 校准)
FONT = "Arial, Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif"
TEXT_FILL = "#969291"          # 原图笔画主体 140-170 灰校准 (dark3%≈119, <140仅2.4%)
TEXT_SIZE = 17.0
TEXT_DY = 5.5                  # 基线 = 行中心 + 5.5 (含降部 bbox 居中校准)

LABELS = [
    "regulation of cell cycle phase transition",
    "ribonucleoprotein complex biogenesis",
    "regulation of mitotic cell cycle phase transition",
    "regulation of chromosome segregation",
    "DNA replication",
    "regulation of antigen receptor-mediated signaling pathway",
    "antigen receptor-mediated signaling pathway",
    "regulation of T cell activation",
    "immune response-activating cell surface receptor signaling pathway",
    "leukocyte homeostasis",
    "myeloid cell homeostasis",
    "lipid homeostasis",
    "antigen processing and presentation",
    "phagocytosis",
    "interferon-mediated signaling pathway",
    "cellular response to interferon-beta",
    "type I interferon production",
    "positive regulation of inflammatory response",
    "response to virus",
    "innate immune response-activating signaling pathway",
    "positive regulation of innate immune response",
    "activation of innate immune response",
    "regulation of innate immune response",
    "cellular response to transforming growth factor beta stimulus",
    "receptor-mediated endocytosis",
    "response to transforming growth factor beta",
    "myeloid leukocyte differentiation",
    "intracellular receptor signaling pathway",
]

# 气泡: (row, col, cx, cy, d, fill)  面积法直径 + 核心色
BUBBLES = [
    (1, 6, 669.5, 41.0, 15.10, "#966596"),
    (2, 6, 669.5, 56.5, 15.47, "#966198"),
    (3, 6, 670.0, 72.0, 14.84, "#8b6296"),
    (4, 6, 669.0, 87.5, 14.05, "#8e6091"),
    (5, 6, 670.0, 103.5, 15.10, "#8a5a93"),
    (6, 5, 644.0, 119.5, 11.78, "#e3b1b7"),
    (7, 5, 644.5, 134.5, 13.54, "#dea7b3"),
    (8, 5, 644.0, 150.5, 14.93, "#d39eb2"),
    (9, 5, 644.0, 166.0, 14.36, "#ce9eb1"),
    (10, 4, 618.5, 182.0, 11.78, "#f9c2ba"),
    (11, 4, 619.0, 197.5, 13.01, "#f5beba"),
    (12, 4, 618.5, 213.0, 13.45, "#e9b6b9"),
    (13, 4, 618.5, 228.5, 13.77, "#e6aeb7"),
    (13, 5, 644.0, 228.5, 12.57, "#f8b6b8"),
    (14, 4, 619.0, 244.0, 14.05, "#dea8b4"),
    (15, 3, 593.5, 260.0, 11.51, "#f3babb"),
    (16, 3, 593.0, 276.0, 10.82, "#f8b8ba"),
    (17, 3, 593.5, 291.0, 12.10, "#e6afb8"),
    (18, 3, 593.5, 306.5, 12.87, "#dda8b4"),
    (19, 2, 568.0, 322.5, 14.71, "#ce9ab0"),
    (20, 2, 568.0, 338.0, 13.73, "#cc9bb0"),
    (21, 2, 568.5, 353.5, 14.63, "#c696ad"),
    (22, 2, 568.0, 369.5, 14.32, "#c994ad"),
    (23, 2, 568.0, 385.0, 14.88, "#bb8aa8"),
    (23, 3, 593.5, 385.0, 14.63, "#c390a8"),
    (24, 1, 543.0, 400.5, 14.23, "#e0aab2"),
    (25, 1, 543.0, 416.5, 14.14, "#dea8b5"),
    (26, 1, 543.0, 432.0, 13.87, "#dca7b4"),
    (27, 1, 543.0, 447.5, 14.32, "#dba5b3"),
    (28, 1, 542.5, 463.5, 14.63, "#d39db2"),
]

# 底部亚群圆点: (cx, cy, d, fill) — y475..493 实测, 核心纯色
GROUP_DOTS = [
    (542.5, 484.0, 19.0, "#9c7bab"),
    (568.0, 484.0, 19.0, "#f9c08b"),
    (593.5, 484.0, 19.0, "#e57a77"),
    (619.0, 484.0, 19.0, "#bda6c9"),
    (644.0, 484.0, 19.0, "#fd9b2a"),
    (669.5, 484.0, 19.0, "#fecdca"),
]

# 色条渐变 (x=697..710, y=149..209; 采样列 x=701..707, offset=(y-149)/60)
CB_X, CB_Y, CB_W, CB_H = 697, 149, 14, 61
CB_STOPS = [
    (149, "#9971a0"), (155, "#936199"), (159, "#986695"), (163, "#a06e9c"),
    (167, "#a6719f"), (171, "#ad77a0"), (175, "#b37fa4"), (179, "#ba84a8"),
    (183, "#bf8aa9"), (187, "#c794ac"), (191, "#ce99af"), (195, "#d6a0b2"),
    (199, "#dca6b3"), (203, "#e5afb7"), (207, "#eab6b6"), (209, "#eab6b6"),
]
# 色条刻度: (值, 数字中心y)  实测
CB_TICKS = [("40", 161.0), ("30", 175.0), ("20", 188.0), ("10", 202.0)]

# Gene Ratio 图例圆: (中心y, 直径, 标签) 面积法实测; 数字标签右对齐 x=756.5
GR_CIRCLES = [(267.4, 12.21, "0.05"), (283.1, 15.31, "0.10"),
              (302.5, 17.73, "0.15"), (324.9, 19.58, "0.20")]
GR_CX = 708.6
GR_LABEL_X = 756.5
LEGEND_NUM_SIZE = 15.0        # 图例数字 (实测 "40" 宽16 / "0.05" 宽29)
LEGEND_NUM_DY = 5.5
LEGEND_FILL = "#878482"       # 图例数字浅灰校准
LEGEND_TITLE_FILL = "#6f6c6b"  # 图例标题核心实测 #827f7e (细笔画含AA)

# ---------------- 渲染 ----------------
def esc(s):
    return (s.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;"))

def row_center(i):
    return TOP + (i + 0.5) * PITCH

def build():
    p = []
    a = p.append
    a(f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" width="{W}" height="{H}">')
    a('<title>亚群富集气泡图 (D) — 忠实重建自参考图</title>')

    # defs: 色条渐变 (offset 必须 0..1)
    a('<defs>')
    a('<linearGradient id="cb-grad" x1="0" y1="149" x2="0" y2="209" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">')
    for y, c in CB_STOPS:
        off = (y - CB_Y) / (CB_Y + CB_H - CB_Y)
        a(f'  <stop offset="{off:.4f}" stop-color="{c}"/>')
    a('</linearGradient>')
    a('</defs>')

    # 面板标签 D (实测 ink y25..46 x0..17, 核心近黑)
    a('<g id="panel-label">')
    a(f'  <text id="panel-d" x="-1.5" y="46.5" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="29" font-weight="bold" fill="#101010">D</text>')
    a('</g>')

    # y 轴标签 (右对齐)
    a('<g id="y-labels">')
    for i, s in enumerate(LABELS):
        cy = row_center(i)
        baseline = cy + TEXT_DY
        a(f'  <text id="ylabel-{i+1}" x="{TEXT_RIGHT}" y="{baseline:.2f}" text-anchor="end" '
          f'font-family="{FONT}" font-size="{TEXT_SIZE}" fill="{TEXT_FILL}">{esc(s)}</text>')
    a('</g>')

    # 绘图框 — 按原图逐像素灰度复现 (原图为缩图: 主线+两侧 AA 扩散翼共~4px)
    a('<g id="plot-frame">')
    # 上边 (y31..35 实测灰度)
    a('  <line x1="524" y1="31.5" x2="688" y2="31.5" stroke="#cbcbcb" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="524" y1="32.5" x2="688" y2="32.5" stroke="#9a9a9a" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="524" y1="33.5" x2="688" y2="33.5" stroke="#7e7e7e" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="524" y1="34.5" x2="688" y2="34.5" stroke="#959595" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="524" y1="35.5" x2="688" y2="35.5" stroke="#c7c7c7" stroke-width="1"/>')
    # 下边 (y470..473)
    a('  <line x1="524" y1="470.5" x2="688" y2="470.5" stroke="#d3d3d3" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="524" y1="471.5" x2="688" y2="471.5" stroke="#6b6b6b" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="524" y1="472.5" x2="688" y2="472.5" stroke="#5e5e5e" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="524" y1="473.5" x2="688" y2="473.5" stroke="#c7c7c7" stroke-width="1"/>')
    # 左边 (x522..525)
    a('  <line x1="522.5" y1="32" x2="522.5" y2="473" stroke="#d7d7d7" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="523.5" y1="32" x2="523.5" y2="473" stroke="#8f8f8f" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="524.5" y1="32" x2="524.5" y2="473" stroke="#5f5f5f" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="525.5" y1="32" x2="525.5" y2="473" stroke="#969696" stroke-width="1"/>')
    # 右边 (x685..688)
    a('  <line x1="685.5" y1="32" x2="685.5" y2="473" stroke="#c1c1c1" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="686.5" y1="32" x2="686.5" y2="473" stroke="#7f7f7f" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="687.5" y1="32" x2="687.5" y2="473" stroke="#5b5b5b" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('  <line x1="688.5" y1="32" x2="688.5" y2="473" stroke="#ababab" stroke-width="1"/>')
    a('</g>')

    # 气泡 (按行分组)
    a('<g id="bubbles">')
    for r in range(1, NROW + 1):
        members = [b for b in BUBBLES if b[0] == r]
        if not members:
            continue
        a(f'  <g id="row-{r}">')
        for (_, c, cx, cy, d, fill) in members:
            a(f'    <circle id="bubble-r{r}-c{c}" cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" r="{d/2:.2f}" fill="{fill}"/>')
        a('  </g>')
    a('</g>')

    # 底部亚群圆点
    a('<g id="group-dots">')
    for j, (cx, cy, d, fill) in enumerate(GROUP_DOTS, 1):
        a(f'  <circle id="group-dot-{j}" cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" r="{d/2:.2f}" fill="{fill}"/>')
    a('</g>')

    # 图例: 颜色条
    a('<g id="legend-colorbar">')
    a(f'  <text id="colorbar-title" x="697" y="141.5" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="15" fill="{LEGEND_TITLE_FILL}">'
      f'&#8722;log<tspan font-size="10" dy="3.2">10</tspan><tspan dy="-3.2">(p.adjust)</tspan></text>')
    a(f'  <rect id="colorbar" x="{CB_X}" y="{CB_Y}" width="{CB_W}" height="{CB_H}" fill="url(#cb-grad)"/>')
    for tick, ty in CB_TICKS:
        a(f'  <text class="cb-tick" x="733" y="{ty + LEGEND_NUM_DY:.1f}" text-anchor="end" '
          f'font-family="{FONT}" font-size="{LEGEND_NUM_SIZE}" fill="{LEGEND_FILL}">{tick}</text>')
    a('</g>')

    # 图例: Gene Ratio
    a('<g id="legend-gene-ratio">')
    a(f'  <text id="gr-title" x="696.5" y="251.8" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="15" fill="{LEGEND_TITLE_FILL}">Gene Ratio</text>')
    for cy, d, lab in GR_CIRCLES:
        a(f'  <circle class="gr-circle" cx="{GR_CX}" cy="{cy}" r="{d/2:.2f}" fill="#101010"/>')
        a(f'  <text class="gr-label" x="{GR_LABEL_X}" y="{cy + LEGEND_NUM_DY:.1f}" text-anchor="end" '
          f'font-family="{FONT}" font-size="{LEGEND_NUM_SIZE}" fill="{LEGEND_FILL}">{lab}</text>')
    a('</g>')

    a('</svg>')
    return "\n".join(p)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    svg = build()
    OUT.write_text(svg, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"written: {OUT}  ({len(svg)} bytes)")
